decision_conditions: Condition 4 is to be amended to:

The external facing materials used to construct the development shall be in accordance with External Material Schedule Pine Lodge and and Drawing Reference PR0113-019-R1and shall be retained as such, unless otherwise submitted in writing to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and to ensure that the proposed development does not
have an adverse effect upon the appearance of the existing building in accordance with Policy
DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020)

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, all other conditions relating to planning permission reference 77146/APP/2023/3464, dated 19/01/2024 , must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
